tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Transcribe a local audio or video file. NOT SUPPORTED on the remote transport — local paths don't exist on the server. Use `transcribe_url` with a publicly reachable URL, or upload via whipscribe.com.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll the current status of a transcription job by job_id.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch a finished transcript in the requested format. Returns a 300-character preview plus a link to the full transcript; large transcripts are not inlined in the MCP response.

tools.name: list_recent_jobs
tools.description: List jobs submitted by the authenticated caller. Stores only job_id, source kind, status, duration, and created-at timestamp — never URLs, file paths, or transcripts.

tools.name: transcribe_urls_batch

tools.name: library_create_folder

tools.name: library_get_folder
tools.description: Read a single library folder including its items array. Use this when you need the contents (transcripts, links, files, notes) the user has placed in the folder.

tools.name: library_add_item

tools.name: library_trash_item

tools.name: library_restore_item
tools.description: Restore a trashed item — clears its deleted_at flag so it shows up in the regular folder again. Use the result of library_list_trash to get the (folder_id, item_index) pair.

tools.name: library_list_trash
tools.description: List every trashed item across the user's library, newest in trash first. Each entry: {folder_id, folder_name, item_index, item, deleted_at}.

tools.name: library_empty_trash
tools.description: Permanently delete every trashed item. Use after the user has reviewed library_list_trash and confirmed they want the items gone for good. Returns {purged: <count>}.

tools.name: library_share_folder
tools.description: Mint a read-only share link for a library folder. Returns a signed URL the user can paste anywhere; recipients can view the folder + its items without signing in. Default expiration 30 days, max 365.

tools.name: list_recipes

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Fetch one recipe by id, including the full prompt body so you can follow it. Use after list_recipes to read the recipe before running it.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description:
Save a new private recipe (a prompt template) owned by the current user. Once saved it shows up in list_recipes(scope='mine') and on /home#recipes for the user to run.

tools.name: delete_recipe

tools.name: update_workflow
tools.description: Update a workflow. Owner-only. Pass only the fields to change; graph fields (name / nodes / connections / settings / active) round-trip to n8n, metadata (description / is_public / tags) updates the Wh

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Delete a workflow on n8n. Permanent — there's no soft-delete. Confirm with the user before calling.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Trigger an execution of a workflow. Pass `data` to feed the first node's input (otherwise n8n uses the workflow's default trigger payload). Returns an execution record — use it to check status / pull

tools.name: request_upload_url

tools.name: clips_prepare
tools.description: Ensure clip-selection features are computed for a transcribed job. First call kicks a background preprocess (~30-60s) and returns status='processing'; later calls return status='ready' with a summary

tools.name: clips_get_summary
tools.description: High-level orientation for a prepared job: total duration, sentence count, hook/question/number counts, energy stats, top 5 highest-energy seconds, speakers. Always start here before proposing clips.

tools.name: clips_search_transcript
tools.description: Substring + token search across the transcript's sentences. Returns matching sentences with start/end timestamps, speaker, and feature flags (is_question, has_hook, has_number, energy_avg). Use when t

tools.name: clips_get_sentences_in_range
tools.description: Pull every sentence in [start_s, end_s]. Use to read context around a candidate hook before locking in clip boundaries — good clips start on a clean entry and end on a clean payoff, not mid-sentence.

tools.name: clips_get_high_signal
tools.description: Pre-flagged candidate sentences. `kind` filters to one of: hook | question | number | speaker_change | high_energy. Use as a starting point when the user wants viral moments without naming a topic.

tools.name: clips_render
tools.description: Render a 9:16 vertical mp4 from [start_s, end_s] of the source video. Synchronously returns video_url when done (~5-15s). Stores the clip under the user's library so it appears on the Shorts page in W

tools.name: list_my_clips
tools.description: List the caller's rendered clips, newest first. Returns video_url + title + virality_score + status for each. Use when the user asks 'what clips do I have' or wants to share a previously rendered one.
